candidate_relations.reason: The stable muscle-like accessory band medial and parallel to the medial rectus supports an accessory extraocular muscle, without the enlargement or other findings expected in thyroid ophthalmopathy.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Different extraocular muscle disorder and etiology

candidate_relations.reason: The lesion has enhancement and signal identical to extraocular muscle and follows a parallel muscle course, favoring an accessory extraocular muscle rather than nonspecific orbital fibrosis.
The long-term stable linear muscle-like structure is inconsistent with orbital myositis and instead supports an accessory extraocular muscle.
